items.title: Full-stack observational fishtank: appetitive-sequence + affect->behaviour coupling instrumentation (Section 9 item 1 of 906b review)
items.note: Section 9 item 1 of observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b_2026-08-09.md (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/) -- appetitive-sequence + affect->behaviour coupling instrumentation on the SAME ecology as V3-EXQ-906b (no config/curriculum change; no supersedes -- purely additive). GOV-REUSE-1 checked: grepped evidence/experiments/ for the six new coupling-metric field names (coupling_dread_t_to_harm_t1t3_*, coupling_surprise_spike_*, etc.) -- zero hits, not recorded anywhere, so this run is not recoverable from existing manifests; ran fresh. PART (a) of the Section 9 design (surface liking/residue-wanting per step) was ALREADY LANDED by a sibling chip (chip-20260809-906b-surprise-telemetry, 2026-08-09T19:00:45Z, REE_assembly master befb35db27 + ree-v3 main 730281cd4b+bd90e8ddbe) before this script was authored -- _read_affect now surfaces VALENCE_WANTING/LIKING/SURPRISE alongside excite/dread, and 906b's own _observational_run (imported unchanged here) already threads them through per-step. This driver adds only the missing manifest-level aggregation for those three channels (mean/std, previously only per-step) plus PART (b): six affect->behaviour coupling metrics as first-class metrics fields, computed in-run, pooled across all episodes/seeds, within-episode only (no cross-boundary lag, matching the review's own Section 4/12b methodology) -- dread(t)->harm[t+1..t+3], z_goal(t)->approach[t+1], z_goal(t)->benefit[t+1..t+3], dread<->z_harm_a (contemporaneous), excite<->benefit (contemporaneous), and surprise-spike->mode-change/movement at p90/p95/p99 thresholds (0.040/0.084/0.233, empirical anchors from the review's Section 12b residue_surprise distribution). PART (c) judgement call: SD-RESIDUE-VALENCE-BOUND (906a-autopsy-routed, unclamped RBFLayer.update_valence accumulator fix) had NOT landed in claims.yaml as of authoring (grepped empty) -- queued now rather than held on an unrelated /governance dependency with unknown ETA, since excite-coupling is only one of six new metrics; it is computed for continuity with the review's own Section 4 figure but explicitly flagged unreliable via metrics.coupling_excite_channel_reliable=0.0 plus prose in interpretation.preconditions and summary_markdown. Re-run this driver once the fix lands if a trustworthy excite reading is needed. PASS/FAIL gates are byte-identical to 906b's (core_channels_non_degenerate, harm_pathway_trained, ecology_survivable, all load-bearing, thresholds unchanged) since the ecology/config is unchanged; added one new non-load-bearing coupling_metrics_computed criterion (n>0 smoke check on the new fields). Diagnostic showcase (claim_ids=[], evidence_direction=non_contributory) -- does not weight governance; re-derive brake N/A (no claim tagged). Smoke: validate_experiments.py --strict OK; dry-run FAIL mechanically (expected at toy scale -- 19 curriculum episodes / 30-step segments vs the real run's 220/500 -- ecology_survivable and freeze/wanting-activation gates need full scale to read meaningfully); [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.998, no writer defect; all six coupling metrics + three channel aggregates populated with sane n (58-60 at dry-run scale) and coupling_metrics_computed=True.

items.title: Sleep-refinement DV probe on fishtank substrate (multi-firing, multi-seed)
items.note: Diagnostic discrimination probe, successor to V3-EXQ-906b (observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b_2026-08-09.md Section 13-C track C / 11a / 12d). Tests whether the sleep-refinement DV (sws_slot_diversity / replay_diversity_index) registers a non-null waking->sleep difference on the repertoire-diverse-but-non-converting fishtank substrate, across 16 segments x 3 seeds (up to 45 forced sleep-cycle firings via SleepLoopManager.force_cycle() at every eval boundary, bypassing the K=10 cadence). GOV-REUSE-1 checked: reanalysis_query.py scanned 867 manifests for the sws_slot_diversity readout on 2026-08-09 -- no manifest carries multi-firing/multi-seed data on this substrate; not recoverable, ran fresh. claim_ids=[] (does not weight governance; re-derive brake N/A). CONFIG DELTA vs 906b (see script docstring for full empirical verification): adds use_anchor_sets=True + use_mech285_sampler=True + use_mech272_routing=True on top of 906b's unmodified config -- these three independently-gated flags are hard structural preconditions for replay_diversity_index to ever be anything other than the -1.0 zero-draws sentinel (confirmed empirically: draws_per_cycle=0 and sleep_replay_sampler=None on 906b's exact config, deterministically, regardless of waking diversity). Confirmed no waking-side behavioural effect (GhostGoalBank/MECH-293 stay ungated; sleep_routing_gate/sleep_replay_sampler are referenced only inside phase_manager._run_cycle). Either outcome (null or non-null) is informative; does not itself unblock GAP-2. Smoke: validate_experiments.py --strict OK, dry-run PASS mechanically (self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at dry-run scale only because sufficient_firing_sample=6<10 -- the pre-registered floor the real run's 45 firings clears easily; all four mechanism-engagement preconditions met True on every seed, sws_slot_diversity_mean=0.045 and replay_diversity_index_mean=0.02 both genuine non-sentinel readings).

items.title: Ecology enrichment for discrete-resource acquisition (Section 9 item 3 of 906b review, lower priority)
items.note: Section 9 item 3 of observational_review_V3-EXQ-906b_2026-08-09.md (REE_assembly/evidence/planning/) -- "Ecology enrichment for food-seeking (design note, lower priority)". EXPLICITLY LOWER PRIORITY than tracks A/C/906c per the review -- queued but not treated as urgent (priority set below both 906c=50 and 909=30). Section 2b found 906b's food-seeking is diffuse proximity/reef-gradient exploitation, not discrete-resource navigation: mean Manhattan distance to nearest resource was 6.23 across all 3909 steps and 6.02 on benefit steps (no closer to a resource when receiving benefit than baseline); only 11 genuine `resource` consummatory transitions occurred, against 1384 `benefit_approach` transitions. ROOT CAUSE (confirmed against source, same methodology 906b used for its own hazard-field fix): `_compute_proximity_fields()` sums `1/(1+dist*resource_field_decay)` over all 5 resources -- structurally identical to the hazard summed-field 906b already fixed, but `resource_field_decay` (separate config field, untouched default 0.5) was left unmodified. A standalone Monte-Carlo probe (500 random 5-resource layouts, same method as 906b's own hazard grid-search) confirmed the untouched field is active on P(active|any distance)=1.000 -- effectively grid-wide. FIX (both of the review's named levers applied): resource_field_decay 0.5->3.0 (grid-searched over {1.5,1.8,2.0,2.2,2.5,2.8,3.0,3.5} at the unchanged shared proximity_approach_threshold=0.4 -- 906b's hazard-side tuning is untouched, since resource_field_decay is independent of hazard_field_decay; chosen value measures P(active|d=1)=0.918, P(active|d=2)=0.261, P(active|d>=3)=0.006, closely mirroring 906b's own hazard curve for a genuine "smell before benefit" radius), proximity_benefit_scale 0.03->0.01 (sharper ambient-vs-discrete contrast, mirroring 906b's own proximity_harm_scale gentling), and resource_respawn_on_consume False->True (SD-012, already-GA mechanism, so consumption can recur through a segment instead of a fixed 11-event pool). GOV-REUSE-1 checked: grepped evidence/experiments/ for the new decisive readout (mean_dist_to_resource_benefit_approach_steps) and for resource_field_decay=3.0 -- zero hits, this manipulation is not recorded anywhere; ran fresh. Direct falsifier instrumented in-run: mean_dist_to_resource_all_steps (all-steps baseline, comparable to 906b's 6.23) vs mean_dist_to_resource_benefit_approach_steps (must drop to <=3.0 cells on a >=20-sample floor for the load-bearing benefit_approach_confound_reduced criterion to pass) -- this run does NOT claim improved food-seeking COMPETENCE, only that the environment-level confound is reduced so a future food-seeking metric would measure navigation-to-resource rather than gradient-sitting. PASS gates: core_channels_non_degenerate, harm_pathway_trained, ecology_survivable (unchanged 906b/906c threshold -- hazard side untouched here) all load-bearing, plus the new benefit_approach_confound_reduced load-bearing criterion. n_resource_consume_events is reported (vs 906b's 11-event baseline) but NOT load-bearing -- how much the still-imperfect trained policy exploits the larger consumption budget is an open behavioural-competency question this driver does not force an answer to. Diagnostic showcase (claim_ids=[], evidence_direction=non_contributory) -- does not weight governance; re-derive brake N/A (no claim tagged). No supersedes -- different resource-side ecology from 906b/906c, not a correction of their science. ID-COLLISION NOTE for a future reader: this was originally authored as V3-EXQ-910, but a concurrent session (906b-defensive-orienting-v3, active TASK_CLAIMS claim on ree_core/pag/defensive_orienting.py etc.) had already claimed V3-EXQ-910 for an uncommitted MECH-489/SD-099 defensive-orienting-validation script (experiments/v3_exq_910_mech489_defensive_orienting_validation.py) found sitting untracked in the shared ree-v3 checkout at write time -- renumbered to V3-EXQ-911 before queuing to avoid the collision; the other session's script and queue entry (whenever it lands) should keep V3-EXQ-910. Smoke: validate_experiments.py --strict OK; dry-run FAIL mechanically (expected at toy scale -- 19 curriculum episodes / 30-step segments vs the real run's 220/500; ecology_survivable and the benefit_approach sample-floor both need full scale to read meaningfully, though even at toy scale the confound metric moved in the right direction: benefit_approach-step mean distance 1.4 vs all-steps mean distance 3.18, n=5 -- directionally consistent, not yet statistically meaningful); [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.998, no writer defect; resource_respawn_on_consume confirmed working in a standalone probe at authoring time (5 resources before and after a forced consumption event).
